home.source: roster rows (availability re-read from the injuries feed under the current team)
home.rule: status contains 'Out' → excluded; Day-To-Day and unlisted → simulated (injuryStatus recorded per player so boards can exclude Day-To-Day)

away.source: roster rows (availability re-read from the injuries feed under the current team)
away.rule: status contains 'Out' → excluded; Day-To-Day and unlisted → simulated (injuryStatus recorded per player so boards can exclude Day-To-Day)

home.rule: per draw: Bernoulli(playRate) × N(mean, sd) clipped [0,48], water-filled to 240 + 25·OT with cap 48 + 5·OT

away.rule: per draw: Bernoulli(playRate) × N(mean, sd) clipped [0,48], water-filled to 240 + 25·OT with cap 48 + 5·OT

roster.poolRule: v0: the simulated pool is still box-score history; roster is reconciled, not applied

writeOnce.rule: a game, once written, is never rewritten; only games not yet forecast and still before tip are added
